title: Integrate concurrent worker changes
summary: Integrated the six concurrent AV1/NVENC, Python mutation-stage, WebView export, dependency-disposition, broad-test, and recurring-validation workstreams. Repaired cross-module WebView dependency injection and refresh races, reconciled generated context, and preserved fail-closed media and mutation boundaries.
reason: The concurrent worker streams shared contracts, generated artifacts, WebView controllers, tests, and release evidence. A dedicated integration pass was required to retain intentional work, remove ambiguous ownership, repair split-module runtime defects, and prove the combined repository state instead of relying on isolated worker results.
behavior_before: The six worker streams coexisted in one dirty worktree with stale generated-summary hashes, incomplete integration ownership, and WebView split-module defects that could erase Diagnostics evidence, open an unintended native picker during a stubbed flow, break Rename confirmation, or lose page-owned test fixtures to late refreshes. Combined validation had not been run.
behavior_after: The worker streams are attributable through packets 008-016; generated summaries and navigation maps are current; focused WebView, Python stage, AV1 policy/topology, and Tauri prerequisite checks pass. WebView adapters use current namespace dependencies, cached Diagnostics evidence survives page-scoped refreshes, and browser tests synchronize their owned synthetic fixtures without weakening production scroll or mutation assertions.

EXPECTED BLOCK: a separate launch against the operator's live per-user state reached a visible window and healthy backend but close-readiness refused shutdown; the isolated package-acceptance run proves clean-package close behavior without bypassing live-state safety guards.

PASS: the final integrated runtime produced a verified deployable package and ZIP; required package tests, WebView reliability, tool integration, end-to-end smoke, isolated packaged launch/backend/window detection, runtime-state externalization, immutable install-root checks, safe close, and child-process cleanup all passed.
rollback_plan: Revert packet 016 integration-only WebView wiring, test synchronization, generated-context, audit-tool, and packet-ownership changes while leaving packets 008-015 individually attributable. Re-run summary/map generators and focused gates; do not alter source media, pending-publish manifests, or encoder activation independently of their owning packets.
